systemStatus.detail:
SUN AUG 16 4AM RUN.

TOAST -- DATA GAP: no Saturday Aug 15 report at run time (single-location DPS typically lands ~7:40 AM PT, Group email ~6:26 AM PT). Saturday is the biggest night of the week, so today's brief carries no read on it.

WHAT'S NEW: the richer single-location Daily Performance Summary for Friday Aug 14 arrived Sat Aug 15 ~7:40 AM PT with daypart, revenue-center, sales-category and 4-WEEK-AVERAGE detail that was missing from the Group email used yesterday. Two corrections to yesterday's brief:
1) 4-week Friday average net is $8,022.62 (not $7,418.39). Aug 14 at $6,511.90 is -18.8% vs that average, not -12.2%. The miss is meaningfully worse than reported.
2) Labor at 18.7% of net was called 'best in weeks' -- true against the recent weekday run (Aug 13: 22.6%, Aug 12: 32.1%, Aug 11: 34.6%), but against FRIDAYS specifically it is above baseline: SDLW 17.0%, 4-week Friday avg 16.5%. Toast scores it +10.0% vs SDLW and +13.3% vs 4-week avg. Labor was not efficient for a Friday.
The genuine positive stands: ticket size rose across the board -- avg order $42.01 (+11.5% SDLW, +4.2% vs 4-wk), avg guest $25.54 (+6.1%, +1.2%), avg check $39.95 (+10.2%, +5.1%). Fewer covers, each spending more.
FULL AUG 14 DETAIL: Gross $6,779.15, discounts $267.25 (3.9%), voids $77.00 on 8 items (-58.1% SDLW, a good number), refunds $0, deferred $0. 255 guests / 155 orders / 163 checks.
DAYPARTS: Dinner $4,403.70 net (67.6%, $59.51/order), Lunch $1,698.20 (26.0%, $39.49/order), Espresso Service $410.00 (6.2%, $10.51/order).
REVENUE CENTERS: Dining Room $3,321.65 (51.0%), Patio $1,617.90 (24.8%, $80.90/order -- highest-yield room), Front Patio $683.85 (10.5%, $85.48/order), Back Room $533.50 (8.1%, $106.70/order), Espresso Bar $343.25 (5.2%), Online Ordering $11.75.
CATEGORIES: Food $3,577.40 (54.9%, 227 items), Draft Beer $1,216.50 (18.6%, 146 items), Liquor $869.00 (13.3%, 71), Espresso $355.00 (5.4%, 72), Wine $271.00 (4.1%, 20), NA Bev $132.00 (2.0%, 25), Bottled Beer $69.00 (1.0%, 10), Retail $22.00.
Off-premise is negligible: 1 take-out order, $11.75. 99.8% of net was in-store.

unanswered.text: great food staff was on point very friendly, I highly recommend it and definitely driving 3 hours to go back.
unanswered.draftReply: Sergio, three hours each way is about the highest compliment a kitchen can get -- thank you. Glad the crew took care of you; they earned that one. Come see us next trip down, first round's on the house. -- The Brewhouse

unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Betty, so glad you and your pup both found what you were after. The patio is one of our favorite things about this place and dogs are always welcome out there. Safe travels home to San Diego -- stop in again next time you're headed down the coast. -- The Brewhouse

unanswered.text: Beer was not good at all. Got botulism from taco. Recovering now. Avoid this place.
unanswered.draftReply: Donald, I'm sorry to hear you've been unwell. A report like this is something I take seriously and want to look into properly. Please reach out to me directly at the restaurant so I can get the date and details of your visit and review it with our kitchen. I hope you're feeling better. -- Joal, The Brewhouse
